scope: Paired bounded first-party Software tasks; no arbitrary repository repair or LLM claim
budget: Calls, wall time, cost and source Task max_steps bound the whole episode. Nodes/depth/width remain per search, matching Runtime.
order: Rotate conditions by seed and reverse on second repeat; fresh World/Store/Registry/Agent each episode
comparison: Actions, authoritative execution observations, reward-independent success/unsafe and aligned learning labels; audit original Gate hashes and complete receipts before semantic normalization
limitations: Two-step checkout plus two one-step programs; no target throughput, reward or long-term intelligence metric; native task proposals already repair these tasks
